development_feasibility.scope: Development generator feasibility, not per-test-case solvability

source_family_protocol.state_coordinates: block-body x/y at the branch root and goal
source_family_protocol.held_out_from: additional adaptation and development; not base pretraining or physical readout

sampling_protocol.order: round robin over fixed source order; initial depth rotates by source position
sampling_protocol.selection: first candidate passing unchanged construction filters; no evaluated-method outcome selection
sampling_protocol.short_episode_fallback: If no 25-step offset fits, use only (t0=0, offset=episode_length-1); episodes shorter than 2 frames have no candidates

tape_protocol.action_dtype: float32 before arena checks, execution, deduplication and storage
tape_protocol.ordinary_slots: Exactly one arena-valid nominal plus remaining sigma slots allocated by cyclic round robin; an invalid nominal rejects the candidate
tape_protocol.outcomes: All queried outcomes retained, including censored or unsafe branches
tape_protocol.shortfall: Discard construction candidate before querying any branch; stress failure preserves exact test roots and stops
tape_protocol.stress_slots: First floor(n/2) existing contact-target stress primitives, remainder existing toward-hazard primitives
tape_protocol.uniqueness: No duplicate action tapes within a root

sampling_protocol.temporal_distribution: Two distinct (t0, goal_offset) pairs sampled uniformly without replacement from all valid pairs; differs from historical offset-first sampling
